meta.title: Private Indoor Pool & Spa in Méribel — Chalet Yolo
meta.description: Heated private indoor pool, Jacuzzi, sauna and hammam: the wellness area of Chalet Yolo, a luxury catered chalet in Méribel.

hero.title: The luxury of a spa. All to yourselves.
hero.subtitle: Private Pool & Spa · Méribel

pool.title: Pool & Jacuzzi
pool.text: Indoor, heated and entirely private, the chalet's pool and Jacuzzi await you after a day on the slopes. Pool towels, bathrobes and slippers are provided.

spa.title: Sauna & Hammam
spa.text:
A complete spa, fully equipped for your comfort: sauna, hammam and sensory showers.
In-chalet massages and treatments on request, à la carte.
